items.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995
items.q: Freddie Green and the trains would come in and they would stop, you know, abruptly back and forth, and between where you stepped from the curb to the train there was an opening, it wasn’t closed off. And I slipped under somehow.

ctx.x: Freddie Green and the trains would come in and they would stop, you know, abruptly back and forth, and between where you stepped from the curb to the train there was an opening, it wasn’t closed off. And I slipped under somehow. And I remember he just came, I don’t know where he was, but he came and pulled me up and I remember being very upset about it.
Yes, scared to death, me too.
